hint.text: Remember to choose the correct form of 'to have' for each form.

instruction.text: Fill in the gaps with the present perfect form of the verbs.

atoms.b: I ((have_waited)) an hour for the bus to arrive.
Flora ((has_read)) two books for school this week.
My parents ((have_decided)) that we are moving house.
Charlie ((has_been)) in London on a school trip.

wrong.text: The verb 'to be' is irregular. For the present perfect form, you need the past participle form of 'to be'.

instruction.text: Fill in the gaps with the past perfect form of the verbs.

atoms.b: Jake ((had_done)) all of his homework before Jessie.

wrong.text: The verb 'to do' is an irregular verb. For the past perfect form, you need the past participle form of the verb 'to do'.

atoms.b: Elsie ((had_seen)) the new horror film already.

wrong.text: The verb 'to see' is an irregular verb. For the past perfect form, you need the past participle form of the verb 'to see'.

atoms.b: Linda ((had_gone)) away for a week before she went back to work.

wrong.text: The verb 'to go' is an irregular verb. For the past perfect form, you need the past participle form of the verb 'to go'.

atoms.b: Ian ((had_forgotten)) his pencil case three times in a row.
